use_cases: Interactive background for landing pages that responds to cursor movement
Decorative hero section element with click-triggered ripple effects
Ambient visual layer for web applications with subtle wave animations
Portfolio or creative website background with engaging mouse interaction
Engaging visual element for product demos or marketing sites
ai_summary: An interactive canvas-based dot pattern that creates a dynamic grid of dots responding to mouse movement with smooth displacement animations and ripple effects triggered on click. The component renders a warm minimalist background with gray dots that animate in wave-like patterns, providing an engaging interactive layer for landing pages, hero sections, or decorative backgrounds. Configurable through props for colors, spacing, and animation speed.
